blocking.title: A player's landing on a non-enemy coast (an ally's, a neutral's) is carried out, told 'Landed', and the next day the division is put back at its capital across the sea, untold
blocking.evidence: critic/shots/c32lp_eng_calais_h66.png, critic/shots/c32lp_eng_calais_h84.png, critic/shots/c32lp_eng_calais_quiet_h120.png, critic/c32_lp_eng_calais_quiet.json, critic/c32_lh_3517.json (Calais t74 -> London t98), critic/c32_lh2_usa_calais.log (US division landed at Calais t730, at its spawn t745), critic/c32_lh2_eng_bergen.log (Bergen t180 -> London t193), critic/scripts/c32_cellwho.ts (foreignTo ENG/FRA true); src/sim/systems/movement.ts repatriationSystem (c.x = spawnPoint) vs seaConvoy (hasLanding only)
blocking.fix: Refuse a player's order over the sea whose landing is on ground foreignTo the nation, with the reason the land march gives; or keep a division where its player's landing put it; never move a land formation across the sea without transports, and tell any repatriation in the formation's panel and the ticker.
